name: Johannes Lechner
headline: Fintech Product Leader & Angel Investor
summary:
I am an entrepreneurial and results oriented product leader with a strong Fintech background. 

As part of amazing teams I have a proven track record of getting Fintech companies and products from „zero to one“ at Payworks and from „one to many“ at Visa.

positions.title: Senior Director - Card Present Product Strategy & Corporate Development
positions.description:
Overall result: Visa Acceptance Solutions now has a competitive   „out-of-the-box“ Card Present product with key clients already live.

Details:
Envisioned the new product strategy for the 2020s: Revamping the acquired Payworks assets to power Android-based Payment Terminals and Tap-To-Phone solutions.

Evangelised the new strategy with executives and key clients.  

Through those actions secured multi-year funding and early client commitments.

Broke down the product strategy into actionable projects for a   100+ people organisation using OKR methodology.

Owned build/buy/partner decisions for additional components/products/companies  required to turn product strategy into reality.

positions.title: Co-Founder - Head of Product (Exited to Visa)
positions.description:
Overall result: Payworks built a card present gateway product from scratch used by over 50000+ merchants; Multi-hardware-vendor, multi-acquirer, multi-operating-system and multi-country.   
Exited the company to Visa, one of our key clients.
 

Details:
Recruited, mentored and ran a 8-people product team.

Owned the overall product roadmap and ran regular product planning sessions with key clients including Visa, Barclays, Global Payments and Concardis/Nets/Nexi. 
 
Significant P/L contributions by convincing key clients to fund strategic product extensions.   

Owned relationships with terminal vendors and other partners.

positions.title: Apple iOS Developer and Consultant
positions.description:
Built iPad app for field service technicians from scratch, trained new iOS devs at eMundo. 

Contributed features to Outbank, a leading German multi-banking iPhone app.
